LEVEL REFERENCE

Bashful Valley

Game data v30 · build 254Sources & research notes

Hidden among the mountains, Bashful Valley has become a haven for the shy. Ironically, connecting through shared experiences has made the town more social, sparking a desire to grow and open up to the outside world.
